The Zelda series has been somewhat inconsistent on Link's sidekicks/assistants/companions. For the first few 2D games, none existed. Then once Navi was introduced in Ocarina of Time, it seemed to be an ongoing trend with Tatl in MM, King of Red Lions in Windwaker, Midna in Twilight Princess, Fi in Skyward Sword, etc. I believe the only recent game without any sort of partner for Link was A Link Between worlds, though Ravio may somewhat be considered that.

Based on this strong trend, we could probably assume there will be some sort of partner character in Zelda U. However, with the game looking like it will change the formula in a few ways, and no such character shown so far, it's still somewhat up in the air. What do you think they'll do? And if you think they will include a companion, what sort of character do you hope it is?

Bonus Question: Out of all the companions Link has had so far, which is your favorite?
Zelda Question of the Day 7/19: Should Link have a companion in Zelda U? If so, what would you like for it to be?

I think a companion for Link is great, so long as the hand holding isn't too extreme like seen in Majora's Mask 3ds remake, I just finished the playthrough this afternoon and I have to say it's horrendous the amount of times the fairy literally gives away the secret.

I'd like to see Kaepora Gaebora make a comeback, but this time having him able to fight along your side every once and awhile, something about riding into a fight on Epona and being able to call in Kaepora to unleash a holy storm of vengeance just seems amazing!
I'm one of the few people who really loves Navi so i'd like to see her or another fairy make a comeback!
